description: This file contains unit tests for the WorkActivityStore class, verifying its behavior in handling jobs and tools, icon state transitions, and label extraction in a Swift application.

classes.name: WorkActivityStoreTests
classes.description: A struct containing unit tests for the WorkActivityStore, testing job handling, icon state management, and label processing.

methods.name: main session job preempts other
methods.description: Tests that a main session job preempts other jobs and updates the icon state and current session key accordingly.

methods.name: job stays working after tool result grace
methods.description: Verifies that the work icon remains in a working state after tool result handling, respecting a grace period before updating to idle.

methods.name: tool label extracts first line and shortens home
methods.description: Checks that tool labels correctly extract the first line of command output and shorten home directory paths.

methods.name: resolve icon state honors override selection
methods.description: Ensures that the icon state resolution respects override selections such as setting to idle or overridden states.
